suite: a press that writes says so at once (the pitch plate's Keep: pending in the frame, one event, the body, the time)
expect_red: [real] Keep on the pitch plate's link bore reads writing and is disabled in the frame of the press, and the other writing controls wait

mutations.contract: The page holds its write in flight from the press until the pane answers it: the pressed control keeps reading pending through every repaint, and every other writing control waits (the pane writes one at a time and drops a second press).
mutations.note: The page forgets its write at once, so its own synchronous repaint draws the pressed Keep back as Keep and the other Keep and Unbind as free.
mutations.find: bodyWrite = { key: VA.bodyCommandKey(cmd), id: id, state: VA.WRITE_PRESS_STATES[0], reason: null };
